title: pcode-snippet parser whole face (generator-absorbed equivalence unit): PcodeSnippet::parseStream parse trees and error texts over p-code semantic strings
status_note: Lane PCODEFACE (wt/pcodeface, base 6a458387). The locked Ghidra 12.0.4 snippet compiler (oracle commit e40ed130) was driven on a bare SLEIGH engine over the production x86-64.sla — the same const SleighBase* handle PcodeInjectLibrarySleigh::parseInject hands to PcodeSnippet (inject_sleigh.cc:387-416) — and the lane-tree Rugra recursive-descent driver (src/pcodeparse.rs) with the FaceLanguage symbol-lookup host. covered_projection.name: generator_absorbed pcodeparse face: PcodeLexer + PcodeSnippet + yyparse skeleton equivalence unit (12 ledger members)

oracle_capture.note: The unmodified PcodeSnippet/PcodeLexer members run inside the locked oracle through the public parseStream/setUniqueBase/getUniqueBase/clear/addOperand/releaseResult surface on a real Sleigh engine (x86-64.sla, 5 spaces, register varnodes RAX..RIP/SF/ZF/AL, userop cpuid=44). The lexer table bug ('||' misses the binary search — KUNAUB-IDENTS-PIN-0001) and the unreachable OP_NEW rule (no 'new' entry in the 46-entry idents table) are pinned as shared dead behavior: both sides emit the same error records.

lexer face lx01-lx06 (comments incl. tail comment without newline, s/f special2/special3 operators s<= s>= s>> f== f!=, identifiers with dot/underscore and s/f-prefixed non-keywords, hex/dec, 2^64-1 boundary, illegal character '$'); lifecycle LF (setUniqueBase/getUniqueBase + allocateTemp offsets in XML, clear drops non-space symbols, clear keeps tempbase (offset 0x10 after clear), clear resets label counter (labels=1, const_relative 0x0), clear resets error state, addSymbol duplicate via addOperand('ram'), addOperand handles in0/in1 incl. handle-based INT_ADD and SUBPIECE, releaseResult second-call null).

known_deltas.note: After an action error the recursive-descent driver skips to the next ';' and continues parsing where Bison aborts at the first error (YYERROR). Invisible to the fixture projection (both sides print the same first error text; the recovered tail is never emitted because hasErrors forces the ERR channel), registered as the standing PARSER-0001 lifecycle note — the case matrix keeps every post-error statement inert.

OP_NEW snippets (ex20) parse-fail on BOTH sides with 'Unknown varnode parameter: new' — the 46-entry idents table has no 'new' entry, so the lexer can never produce OP_NEW through the snippet face (pcodeparse.y:228-276). '||' similarly misses the binary search (table sort inversion, pinned byte-exact by KUNAUB-IDENTS-PIN-0001 and exercised by ex09). Both records pin the shared dead behavior rather than a divergence.

Driver sub-faces not exercised by the matrix: 'Multiple delayslot declarations' (DELAY_SLOT ops unreachable through the snippet grammar), SleighError 'Could not construct requested bit range' (needs real offset + non-real size, unreachable), 'Localtemp size mismatch' escape (implemented on the hard-error channel, unreachable through the grammar), illegal-char handling beyond '$' (lx06 pattern covers the endstream/EOF-abort path), 256-byte token truncation, and nonassoc chained comparisons (a > b > c is a bison syntax error; the precedence climber parses it — grammar-face difference recorded, no production snippet uses chained comparisons).
